_meta.purpose: Maps KPR-OM dealId -> Datex BLDGID(s). Hand-maintained. Datex BLDGIDs are mostly city-based, not name-based, so this cannot be generated by name matching.
_meta.scope: KPR-OM deals with status = Owned only. Deals with any other status have no Datex counterpart.
_meta.cardinality: One deal may map to multiple buildings. Always treat bldgIds as an array.
_meta.queryNote: Datex stores fixed-width character fields, so BLDGID values carry trailing spaces. Filter with the 'contains' operator, never 'eq'.
_meta.glaNote: Buildings.BLDGGLA and Buildings.OCCGLA are 0 on roughly two-thirds of active buildings. Do not source GLA or occupancy from the Buildings entity. Compute from Occupancy / TenantsMetrics, filtering out superseded TenantsMetrics rows (TenantId values carrying a generation suffix such as .0.00011).
_meta.writeNote: Datex values populate a live block alongside the frozen acquisition-era snapshot. Never overwrite the OM-stated fields. Null in Datex means unknown, never zero.
